policy.plain_row: every lot car (a85c654) the app's own OEM-GATE code (pfOemDonorGate, run unchanged through audit11_4/lot_replay.mjs after reading it) shows as a plain row must be able to take the part per the raw rows: product page fitment AND the vehicle-year's own list-page row (Fitting Vehicle Options, Production Date, Location).
policy.trim: trim / option-package limits (FVO trim words, asterisked option variants) count as covered by the group note 'fits some option packages / configurations; verify the number on the part' (task rule).
policy.sibling_specificity: when the vehicle-year's own page lists, for the same part name and position and the same FVO wording, a separate number qualified by a decodable attribute (W. AWD, W. 4WD, KC/CC, an engine code), the unqualified number is read as not covering cars with that attribute; plain rows of such decoded cars are WRONG.
policy.production: production windows are not decodable. A credited model year (MY taken as 07/(y-1)-06/y as the curation does, or the catalog's own changeover where the dated rows show it) whose remaining builds are listed under the part's own predecessor (that number 'Replaced By' this part) or under this part's own direct successor is RIGHT with a remark. Remaining builds listed under a number linked only through a common successor, or not linked, or pages of the same catalog that disagree (dateless on one MY page, a window outside that MY on another) are RISK: the catalog does not list the part for those builds and no lot car's build month is known. Under a strict reading of 'production date' in the WRONG list these RISK items would be WRONG; they are kept apart so the hub can decide.
policy.boundary: 1-2 uncovered months at a model-year edge are not counted (MY convention noise).

production_windows_NEW_CLASS.definition: app vehicle-years where the pn's own-page production window covers less than the whole model year (07/(y-1)-06/y); approximate: other rows of the same part name and position covering the gap, any configuration
production_windows_NEW_CLASS.note: pervasive (111 of 249 groups have at least one such vehicle-year, many only 1-2 boundary months). The curation credits a model year at 5 months of overlap. Sample items where same-configuration builds of a credited year carry a number not linked to the pn are RISK in this report.

recommendation: DO NOT SHIP. 2 WRONG groups in the sample (QX60 mirror 96301-3JA9B and QX56 2013 speedometer 24820-3ZD0A: AWD/4WD donors shown as plain rows although the vehicle-year page lists a separate AWD number for the same option clause); the census finds the same class in 2 more groups (96302-3JA9B, 24820-3ZD1A). Fix before release: a drive gate (or drive_not, 'if equipped') wherever the page lists an AWD/4WD sibling for the same clause; eng gates from the product-page engine column (costs no real donor) and/or keep cars with a VIN/listing mismatch flag out of OEM plain rows; and a hub decision on production windows that split a credited model year (note naming the build window, or require the window to cover most of the year).
